aliases: close a PIN-locked card that cannot be unlocked and replace it
close a cloned card after a chip/CVV mismatch review
close a stolen card that has a pending refund
close several lost debit cards where one is blocked by pending transactions

when.quote: Procedure for when a customer wants to close, cancel, or deactivate their debit card.

starts.note: Agent: after disputes whose card action is close_and_reissue, and when the PIN lock protocol finds unauthorized transactions; close only with the customer's agreement. Customer: starts when the customer asks to close or cancel a card.
starts.quote: If unauthorized transactions found: File dispute, close card, order replacement.

tools.not_used: A freeze is the card action for freeze_pending_investigation, done in the dispute job, not part of closing.
The replacement is ordered in order_replacement_debit_card (replacement_handoff).
A card closed after a fraud dispute keeps its alert (alert_card_not_cleared).
Used in the lost/stolen cross-product protocol that cross_product_handoff starts, not in closing.
Doc 005 is cited only for its tier list. No account is closed here.

info.about: lost, stolen, fraud_suspected, damaged, no_longer_needed or account_closing
info.ask: What is the reason you want to close the card: lost, stolen, suspected fraud, damaged, no longer needed, or closing the account?

info.about: Whether a refund to the card is pending. No lookup reads this.
info.ask: Are you expecting any refunds to this card?

info.about: If a refund is pending: whether the customer acknowledges in writing that it will be credited to the checking account
info.ask: You have a pending refund. You can wait for it to process (typically 3-5 business days), or acknowledge in writing that it will be credited to your linked checking account instead. Which would you prefer?

info.about: For a FROZEN card: whether to unfreeze it so it can be closed
info.ask: This card is frozen. To close it, I would first unfreeze it and then close it right away. Would you like me to do that?

info.about: Whether to order a replacement now
info.ask: Would you like me to order a replacement card right away?

steps.do: Reuse the verification done earlier in the conversation. If there was none, verify the customer first: look up the record, match 2 values, call get_current_time, then log_verification.
Get the current date, for the card's age (from date_issued to today).
steps.quote: Calculate this from the date_issued field.

steps.do: Read the linked checking account's status and account_class.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Read the account's cards again with get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823. Confirm the card's card_id, user_id, status, date_issued and fraud_alert_active.
steps.quote: Before closing a card: Confirm the card_id and current status

basis.quote: Customer must be verified

steps.do: Read the account's transactions and check for entries with status 'pending'.

basis.quote: Customer must be verified
No pending transactions: The card must not have any pending or processing transactions.

steps.do: Ask the customer for the reason they want to close the card (info close_reason), and use the reason they choose.
steps.quote: Ask customer for the reason they want to close the card (select from: lost, stolen, fraud_suspected, damaged, no_longer_needed, account_closing)
Check eligibility requirements. If any requirement is not met, inform the customer what needs to be resolved and do not proceed with closure.

basis.quote: Customer must be the owner of the debit card (verify user_id matches)
The debit card must currently be in ACTIVE or PENDING status

No pending transactions: The card must not have any pending or processing transactions. If pending transactions exist, inform the customer they must wait for all transactions to settle before the card can be closed.
No pending refunds: The card must not have any pending refunds.
or acknowledge in writing that the refunds will be credited to the linked checking account instead.
These reasons bypass the minimum card age requirement (requirement 6) for security purposes
Minimum card age: The debit card must have been active for at least 14 days.

steps.do: Check, close and replace each card on its own. One card failing a check does not stop the others. Tell the customer each card's outcome.
steps.if: more than one card is being closed
steps.quote: Check eligibility requirements. If any requirement is not met, inform the customer what needs to be resolved and do not proceed with closure.

steps.do: Ask the customer (info wants_unfreeze). If they agree, unfreeze the card, which makes it active, then go straight to k_close. If the unfreeze fails, do not close; follow action_error.
steps.if: the card to close is FROZEN, the linked account is OPEN, the other closure checks pass, and the customer agreed to unfreeze-then-close

basis.quote: Card must currently be in FROZEN status
The linked checking account must still be OPEN
Confirm the card is now active and ready to use immediately
The debit card must currently be in ACTIVE or PENDING status

basis.why: No document gives an unfreeze-then-close procedure, so the customer is asked.

steps.do: Tell the customer that any pending transactions will still be processed, and ask whether they want a replacement card ordered right away.
steps.if: the reason is lost, stolen or fraud_suspected and k_eligible passed
steps.quote: Inform customer that any pending transactions will still be processed

basis.quote: If reason is 'lost', 'stolen', or 'fraud_suspected':
Ask if they want to order a replacement card immediately

steps.do: Unlock and call close_debit_card_4721. If the reply is an error (for example, the card's current status does not allow closing), tell the customer what must be resolved and follow action_error.

args.reason: the customer's reason from k_reason: lost, stolen, fraud_suspected, damaged, no_longer_needed or account_closing

steps.if: k_eligible passed, the card is ACTIVE or PENDING (or became active through r_unfreeze), and the customer agreed to close it
steps.quote: Use close_debit_card_4721 to close the card with parameters: card_id, reason

basis.quote: The debit card must currently be in ACTIVE or PENDING status
Confirm the card is now active and ready to use immediately
If unauthorized transactions found: File dispute, close card, order replacement.

basis.clause: error: tell the customer what must be resolved
basis.quote: Check eligibility requirements. If any requirement is not met, inform the customer what needs to be resolved and do not proceed with closure.

steps.quote: The card is now permanently deactivated and cannot be reactivated

basis.quote: Any recurring payments linked to this card will need to be updated with new payment information
If they need a new card, they can order one through the standard ordering process
For fraud_suspected closures, recommend the customer also change their online banking password
If fraud is suspected, advise customer to review recent transactions and file disputes for any unauthorized charges

steps.do: Close the card as it is. Do not clear its fraud alert.
steps.if: the card's fraud_alert_active is TRUE and a fraud dispute on it was filed
steps.quote: If they confirm all transactions are legitimate, clear the alert.

steps.do: Confirm the refund will be credited to the linked checking account.
steps.if: the closed card had a pending refund that the customer acknowledged
steps.quote: Refunds to a closed card will be credited to the linked checking account

steps.do: Get the current time right after the closure and keep it as the closure time. The Entry-tier replacement wait runs from that time to 48 hours later.
steps.if: a card on an Entry-tier account (Light Blue, Light Green, Green Fee-Free) was closed in this conversation
steps.quote: 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered

basis.quote: ENTRY TIER (Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account)

steps.do: Do not order a replacement on that account now. Tell the customer the account already has an active card, and a checking account cannot have more than one active debit card.
steps.if: the closure was blocked, the old card is still ACTIVE, and the customer asks for a replacement on that account
steps.quote: Customer cannot have more than 1 active debit cards per checking account

steps.if: the card was closed and the customer wants a replacement
steps.quote: If they need a new card, they can order one through the standard ordering process

steps.if: the card was closed because it was reported lost or stolen
steps.quote: Complete the standard debit card freeze/close procedure

steps.do: Explain what the reply says failed. If it cannot be resolved, ask whether the customer wants a human agent, and transfer only if they agree.

args.summary: the card actions done and the error

steps.if: a close or unfreeze call returns an error that cannot be resolved, and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request

rules.rule: Only ACTIVE or PENDING cards can be closed. A closed card can never be reopened.
rules.quote: Closed cards cannot be reopened - customer must order a new card if needed

basis.quote: The debit card must currently be in ACTIVE or PENDING status

rules.rule: Lost or stolen cards are closed immediately once the requirements are met.
rules.quote: Cards reported as lost or stolen are closed immediately with no cooling-off period

done_when:
All of the following hold:
- Each card in scope was closed and the closure confirmed, or the customer knows what blocks it.
- Each closed card was handed to the replacement job, or the customer declined a replacement.
- Lost or stolen cards were handed to the cross-product check.
- Any error was explained and a transfer offered.
